messages.subject: problem to download seewave with mac
parts:
Dear Jerome,

I'm having trouble to install seewave with my mac (version 10.5.8). I tried to install "tcltk", and then "fftw","tuneR","rgl","rpanel", before installing seewve but there is this message:
Avis : impossible d'accéder à l'index de l'entrepôt http://cran.at.r-project.org/bin/macosx/leopard/contrib/2.14. In englsih it could be : impossible to access http://cran.at.r-project.org/bin/macosx/leopard/contrib/2.14. Do you have an explanation for me?

Thank you,

Avelyne

messages.author: f0f1270d8b55f174
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] problem to download seewave with mac
parts:
Hi Avelyne,

You should install this before installing seewave:
http://socserv.mcmaster.ca/jfox/Misc/Rcmdr/installation-notes.html
That worked for me. 
Also when setting the wav player, use this (setWavPlayer ("afplay").


O.
